decision.explanation: The source documents explicitly state two distinct awards received by Ernest Beutler. Document 1 (D1S13, D1S18) confirms he received the 'Canada Gairdner International Award' in 1975 for his work in hematology. Document 2 (D2S13) confirms he received the 'Asian/Pacific American Awards for Literature' in 1995 for his poetry collection 'The Blood of Life'. Both answers are directly supported by the text and represent complementary valid responses to the question regarding which awards he received.
